newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-NYMEX oil supports hold in bullish sentime.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-NYMEX oil supports hold in bullish sentime.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
* More volatility is seen today head of the June products futures expiry but general sentiment remains fairly bullish.
* A rally through resistance at $21.46 could bolster confidence in the bullish view for a run back up above $22.47. But an unexpected drop below $20.57 would postpone any rally.

NYMEX crude and products look well supported after Thursday's bounce, but brokers and analysts expected more volatility today head of the products futures expiry although general sentiment remained fairly bullish.
GNI Research warned in their daily report, "There could be more volatility today ahead of the NYMEX products expiry and there could be further long liquidation".
Al Graham at Elliott Wave International in Gainesville, Georgia, said, "It now looks as if we may have the bottom we're looking for at $20.57 now a key support level for an aggressive bullish case."

"We need to see a price rally through resistance at $21.46 to bolster confidence in the bullish view for a run back up above $22.47. An unexpected drop below $20.57 would postpone the rally we have been anticipating, but lower support in the $20.42-$20.27 area should be solid," Graham said.

Fenella Graham at MeesPierson Derivatives Limited took a more balanced view in her daily report. She said that July unleaded gasoline futures were still in a large range between 62.60 and 64.50 cents a gallon but now might have a buying extreme at 62.70 should it test the downside again.
WTI and heating oil are also in extended ranges between $20.64-$21.32 a barrel and 55.00-56.80 cents a gallon respectively.
Of WTI, Graham said, "Until the picture is clearer, play the range, but with Thursday's low volume prints below $20.84 this may prove to be the bottom of any down test."
